dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what are you buying? Chips and cookies again?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ər juː ˈbaɪɪŋ? ˈtʃɪps ənd ˈkʊkiz əˈɡɛn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know, I know. My diet isn't very balanced.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈnoʊ. maɪ ˈdaɪət ˈɪzənt ˈvɛri ˈbælənst.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You ought to eat more fruit and vegetables. They have a lot of vitamins.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈɔːt tu ˈiːt ˈmɔːr ˈfruːt ənd ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz. ðeɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈvaɪtəmɪnz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll buy some oranges, too.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪl ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈɔːrɪndʒɪz, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea! And look at these chips. One bag has five hundred calories!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə! ənd ˈlʊk ət ðiːz ˈtʃɪps. ˈwʌn ˈbæɡ ˈhæz ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈkæləriz!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And they have a lot of fat. You ought not to eat them every day.
dialogue.reading: ənd ðeɪ ˈhæv ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfæt. juː ˈɔːt ˈnɑːt tu ˈiːt ðɛm ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. What other food should I avoid?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt ˈʌðər ˈfuːd ʃʊd aɪ əˈvɔɪd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Soft drinks and ice cream. They have so much sugar.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɔːft ˈdrɪŋks ənd ˈaɪs ˈkriːm. ðeɪ ˈhæv ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈʃʊɡər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You ought to be a doctor, Emma!
dialogue.reading: juː ˈɔːt tə bi ə ˈdɑːktər, ˈɛmə!
